task.title: Shutdown Procedure
task.shortdesc: Follow these steps to safely shut down the GrainFlow X50.

step.cmd: Press the Stop button on the HMI.

info.p: The machine will begin its cooldown cycle (approx 30 seconds).

step.cmd: Wait for the machine to completely stop.

info.p: Do not open any guards until the machine has completely stopped.

step.cmd: Turn the main power switch to the OFF position.
Lock out/tag out the power supply if maintenance is required.

info.p: Always use lock-out/tag-out procedures before performing any maintenance or cleaning.

ul.li: Record production data from the HMI
Note any anomalies observed during operation
Clean the machine if required for the next shift
